questions.question: England's men's football team ended which country's record 43-match unbeaten run with a 3–2 victory in the UEFA Nations League?
questions.explanation: England snapped Spain's historic 43-game unbeaten streak during a UEFA Nations League group fixture.
questions.context: 2026–27 UEFA Nations League: In association football, England defeats Spain 3–2 in the group stage of UEFA Nations League A to end Spain's 43-match unbeaten streak, the longest by a national team.

questions.question: Which non-profit fanfiction website began restoring its service after being knocked offline for more than two weeks by a cyberattack?
questions.explanation: Archive of Our Own slowly resumed functionality seventeen days after experiencing a major online attack.
questions.context: Non-profit fanfiction repository website Archive of Our Own is restored to limited functionality 17 days after being targeted in a cyberattack.

questions.question: Which major clothing-exporting nation closed dozens of factories following widespread protests by garment workers over the minimum wage?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh shuttered numerous clothing factories in key industrial areas following worker demonstrations regarding basic pay.
questions.context: 2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests: Amid minimum wage protests by garment workers, 13 garment factories in Gazipur are shut indefinitely under the Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006 and over 50 remain closed in Savar and Ashulia, while 48 platoons of the Border Guard, Ansar, and Special Response Battalion deploy across industrial zones in Dhaka, Gazipur, and Narayanganj.

questions.story: Estonia–Russia relations, Russian sabotage operations in Europe
questions.question: Which country decided to close all three of its border crossings with Russia after an attempted arson attack on a defence manufacturer?
questions.explanation: Estonian authorities announced the border closures following an attempted attack on drone maker Threod Systems blamed on Russian intelligence.
questions.context: Estonia–Russia relations, Russian sabotage operations in Europe: Estonia announces the closure of its three border crossings with Russia starting December 1 after eight suspects were detained over an attempted arson attack on drone manufacturer Threod Systems, which Estonian intelligence attributes to Russia's GRU.

questions.question: Voters in Gagauzia took to the polls to elect a governor and members of their local assembly in which European country?
questions.explanation: The elections took place in the autonomous region of Gagauzia located within Moldova, heading to a second round for the governorship.
questions.context: 2026 Gagauz general election: Gagauzians in Moldova vote to elect a governor and 35 members of the People's Assembly. MP Alexandr Stoianoglo and Fiodor Gagauz [ru] advance to the second round after no candidate received a majority of the vote.
